rules: Do not invent a second item_code for the same commercial SKU.
Do not create a MUR clone of LR-SETUP-USD-150; MUR on that pilot is invoice-time conversion, not a second master.
CF-RD-LEAD-RESCUE is the MUR sprint product, not a currency copy of the USD 150 launch pilot.
Setup and recurring are separate items (different UOM and billing cadence), not Item Variants.
USD vs MUR for the same SKU uses Price Lists on one item, not two items.
Website Rescue T2/T3 are reserved operator-quote codes; they must not replace or duplicate T1.

items.item_name: AI Lead Rescue Setup (USD 150 launch pilot)
items.commercial_description: AI Lead Rescue Setup — launch pilot. CorpFlowAI connects one agreed lead source to operator alerts and a visible daily follow-up path, with a 48-hour setup window after payment clears and a 7-day monitoring window. No revenue, lead-volume, or conversion guarantees.
items.internal_notes: Operator delivery uses Telegram alerts and a buyer-shared sheet. Those tools must not appear on the quotation/invoice line.

prices.item_standard_rate_note: Company currency is MUR. Do not write USD 150 onto Item.standard_rate.

items.commercial_description: AI Lead Rescue monthly monitoring. Continued daily lead summary, operator alerts on the connected lead source, one lead-source change per month, and a monthly recap. Month-to-month; invoiced in advance. No auto-debit in this phase. No revenue guarantees.
items.internal_notes: Quoted after the 7-day pilot window. Not a public CTA.

prices.item_standard_rate_note: Company currency is MUR. Do not write USD 99 onto Item.standard_rate.

items.commercial_description: AI Lead Rescue Sprint. CorpFlowAI connects one lead source, alerts the named owner instantly, and leaves a visible daily follow-up path. First visible working output within 24–72 hours after deposit clearance and access confirmation. 50% deposit before work; balance on delivery acceptance. No revenue guarantees.
items.internal_notes: MUR rapid-delivery sprint. Separate product from the USD 150 launch pilot.

items.commercial_description: Premium Landing Page Rescue (Website Rescue T1). A bounded landing-page rescue that states the offer clearly, is mobile-ready, and routes buyer intent into a working enquiry path. Two structured preview rounds included. 50% deposit before design/build; balance before production release. No SEO ranking or sales-volume guarantees.
items.internal_notes: Canonical Website Rescue invoicing master. T2/T3 are reserved codes, not copies of this item.

items.commercial_description: Optional Website Rescue monthly maintenance after handover. Month-to-month health checks and bounded minor copy/CTA tweaks, invoiced monthly in advance. Rate is set on the quotation (not a public list price). New pages, redesigns, or extra channels are quoted separately. No revenue guarantees.
items.internal_notes: No canonical monthly MUR amount is approved. Operator enters the quoted rate on the document until Anton sets a list price.

items.commercial_description: Website Rescue Brochure Rescue (T2). A bounded multi-page rescue (typically Home + Services + Contact) with two structured preview rounds. Quoted after discovery. No SEO ranking or sales-volume guarantees.
items.internal_notes: Reserved until Anton W1 affirms the T2 band. Do not create a second T1 master.

items.commercial_description: Website Rescue Bounded Rebuild (T3). A bounded rebuild after a short URL audit, with three structured preview rounds. Quoted after discovery. No SEO ranking or sales-volume guarantees.

items.commercial_description: Customer Recovery & Reputation Management Sprint. A bounded sprint to restore a credible public presence and enquiry path. 50% deposit before work; balance on delivery acceptance. No review-score or revenue guarantees.
